scope: Replace the scheduler-backed courier's source timestamp plus market-data delay with source timestamp minus delay.

mutant.failure: market data reached the actor at its publication instant

method: Fixture-level semantic mutation; scratch source is restored before the result is recorded.
interpretation: The deterministic courier rejects an injected negative-latency look-ahead. This proves only the scheduler-backed message path; it does not make the known direct vanna-volga dealer-inventory read an ordinary delayed market-data observation.
